title: Esrbespoke prose
description: Long text on a hairline: a tiny capital label at the left and, from column 7, paragraphs in 20px text, optionally grouped under small 18px sub-headings with wide gaps between them (for a story or a policy).
notes: spacing "loose" leaves a wide gap between paragraphs, as the original's policy page does
